    Write the widget to a self-contained HTML file and style it

    save_html_and_style.Rd

    Leaflet's own output has no banner, legend or time control; those are added by rewriting the saved file (see inject_banner_legend_controls()). The _files folder that saveWidget() leaves behind is removed — with selfcontained = TRUE everything is already inside the HTML, and the folder would only confuse a user emailing the map.

    Usage

    save_html_and_style(
  map,
  html_file,
  title,
  styling_type,
  show_banner,
  banner_colour,
  colour_scale,
  collapsed_mobile,
  image_mode,
  image_dimensions,
  autoplay,
  play_speed,
  data_max,
  display_times = NULL,
  banner_style = "strip",
  indicator = NULL,
  indicator_label = NULL,
  indicator_show_max = FALSE,
  indicator_placement = "right",
  banner_key = NULL
)

    Arguments

    map

    Leaflet map object

    html_file

    Output path for the HTML

    title

    Banner title

    styling_type

    "html" to inject banner/legend/controls, "none" to skip

    show_banner

    Logical; show the title strip

    banner_colour

    Brand accent colour

    colour_scale

    Name of the colour scale (drives the legend)

    collapsed_mobile

    Logical; start the legend collapsed on small screens

    image_mode

    Logical; use the static-export styling

    image_dimensions

    c(width, height) for the JPG pass; NULL for HTML

    autoplay, play_speed

    Animation settings for the time control

    data_max

    Largest value in the data (legend scaling)

    display_times

    Time steps offered by the control

    banner_style

    "strip" or "bar"

    indicator

    Aggregate figures from build_indicator_data(), or NULL

    indicator_label

    Caption for the indicator, or NULL for the default

    indicator_show_max

    Also mark the network maximum, as a diamond

    indicator_placement

    "right" of the ramp or "under_title"

    banner_key

    Reference-layer key from build_banner_key(), drawn at the end of the banner. NULL for no key.

    Value

    NULL, called for its side effect
